scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @slotwise/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @slotwise/api" "npm run dev -w @slotwise/web"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @slotwise/api && npm run typecheck -w @slotwise/web
